race.comment: Even race but STRUCK GOLD (5) looks hard to beat fresh. Loves it here and is a fresh-up performer. Well placed with the claim and will take catching. Expected to go close. BRUNO BRUNO (10) has raced twice this time in for two minors. Overdue and looks a terrific chance in a suitable contest. SHISUTA BO (8) is on the quick back-up after finishing fifth here in a richer race a few days. Rates highly on best form and has to be included on the quick turn-around. BAHAMA BAY (1) has a great record second-up and looks a big improver. GREAT BUY (3) is a veteran sprinter who has been thereabouts lately. Has a low draw and the claim and should be winding up strongly.
